Which statement about the rusting of iron is correct?
A
The rusting of iron forms hydrated iron(II) oxide.
B
Barrier methods prevent rusting by excluding nitrogen and water.
C
A piece of iron submerged in water will not rust.
D
Coating with plastic is a barrier method that prevents iron rusting.
